digest:
This resolution

• expresses support for a National Voting Rights Month,

• encourages people to uphold the right to vote,

• encourages Congress to pass certain voting rights legislation,

• recommends the development of a curriculum in public schools and universities regarding voting,

• expresses appreciation for the U.S. Postal Service for issuing a special Representative John R. Lewis stamp, and

• invites Congress to allocate funds for public service announcements regarding elections.

effective.note: A simple resolution speaks for one chamber only. It is not a law and has no effective date. This one has not been agreed to in the House.
